description.en:
Changes the kit worn by one match player's model.

The player can be given by parameter ID or by formation number. The kit is stored in the player's on-pitch data as kitId x 1000, plus 2 when the away variant is chosen (the projectz tools read it back this way).
Two optional values are stored in two further fields of that data. The fifth argument goes into a byte field that the projectz tools read back as the "kit number"; the sixth goes into a 16-bit field whose use was not identified (the shipped calls give it the same value as the kit ID).
Nothing changes if the player is not found.
Team of the player: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Player parameter ID (string, e.g. "para_cp0008") or formation number (integer).
Kit ID, e.g. 1, 23, 24 or 903 in the shipped scripts.
0 for the home variant, any other value for the away variant (adds 2 to the stored kit code).
Stored in a byte field of the player's data (read back as the "kit number" by the projectz tools). The shipped scripts pass 0, 1 or 18.
Stored in a 16-bit field of the player's data; its use was not identified. Only read when kitNumber is also given.

true once the call has run, including when the player was not found.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 4 arguments were given.

examples.case: Dressing both teams for a story match (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
Only the kit and its variant (real usage, from btl0007.nut)
examples.code:
// Four-argument form: home variant of kit 24
CMND_BTL_CHANGE_UNIFORM(0, "para_cp0008", 24, 0);

examples.case: Selecting a player by formation number
examples.code:
// Give the goalkeeper slot (number 0) of the opponent the away variant
CMND_BTL_CHANGE_UNIFORM(1, 0, 903, 1);
